name: Alphalete - Indexing and Location Page Plan 2026-07-14
body:
> Plan · Alphalete · 2026-07-14

Companions (same folder): `Alphalete_Indexing_Plan_SIMPLE.docx`, `Alphalete_Indexing_Progress_Tracker.xlsx`, `Alphalete_Local_Pages_Plan.xlsx`, `Alphalete_Local_Pages_Inventory.xlsx`, `Alphalete_Phase2_Plan_and_Redirects.xlsx`

# Summary
The July 14 "Indexing Fix and Location-Page Consolidation Plan", in a full and a simple version, with three supporting spreadsheets and a later Phase 2 matrix. The problem: 220 near-duplicate local pages (5 services x 44 cities) that Google crawled but would not index. Zero location pages earned impressions in the 28 days to Jul 11.

# The plan
- Collapse the 5 service pages per city into 1 all-services area page (core focus trenchless sewer repair / CIPP).
- Keep about 16 real markets, 301 the rest into the nearest kept metro: 220 pages down to 16.
- Make each kept page unique with verifiable local proof (neighborhoods, ZIPs, expansive clay, about 36-inch frost depth, older clay and cast iron laterals), 5 unique FAQs with schema, a featured image, and links from ranking blogs.
- **Keep, Tier 1 (9):** Colorado Springs, Denver, Pueblo, Castle Rock, Monument, Fountain, Parker, Littleton, Canon City.
- **Keep, Tier 2 (7):** Black Forest, Security-Widefield, Woodland Park, Manitou Springs, Lone Tree, Elizabeth, Palmer Lake.
- **Redirect, Tier 3 (28):** tiny towns into the nearest kept city (for example Yoder, Peyton, Calhan to Colorado Springs; Florence, Penrose to Canon City).
- Build Colorado Springs first as a test; always add the redirect before deleting.

# Baseline (28 days to Jul 11)
Clicks 23 (about 7 internal), impressions 4,650, average position 15.1, 22 URLs with any impressions out of about 300, **0 location pages with impressions**.

# Phase 2 matrix
`Alphalete_Phase2_Plan_and_Redirects.xlsx` narrows to 8 metro pages anchored on residential trenchless sewer repair (Colorado Springs, Denver, Pueblo, Castle Rock, Parker, Littleton, Monument, Canon City), each with keyword, supporting terms, nearby areas and old URLs to redirect, plus a 215-row redirect matrix.

# Status
Not carried out as written. In August the decision was 44 root city pages with one primary service each (`/{city}/`), and old service-area URLs were 301'd (36 on Sep 22). Whether to remove about 30 zero-demand small-town pages is still an open question (see [Alphalete - Session Handoff 2026-10-01](lib:brain-alphalete-session-handoff-2026-10-01)).

# Files in this group
- `Alphalete_Indexing_Plan_SIMPLE.docx`: one-page plain version with the keep (16) and redirect (28) list.
- `Alphalete_Indexing_Progress_Tracker.xlsx`: survivor-page checklist and 4 numbers to watch (all baseline 0 for survivor pages indexed and location pages with impressions).
- `Alphalete_Local_Pages_Plan.xlsx`: keep/redirect list and all 220 page URLs.
- `Alphalete_Local_Pages_Inventory.xlsx`: 220 local pages with status and sitemap flag, a city x service matrix and service hub URLs.
- `New Template\Alphalete_Local_Pages_Inventory - Survivor Page.pdf`: survivor page list with keyword volumes per service.
